prompt: Make exactly one memcue_search call: query "quarry pipeline checks", limit 5. Do not search again. Then reply with the id and version of every fact you received, one line each, and stop.
binary: bin/memcue of the branch (0.37.1 plus the rendering change; the CLI, its argv and its JSON are untouched)
facts: five synthetic facts in a throwaway text base, scope global, one search returns all five; no private text
metric: tokens.input + tokens.cache.read of the step that follows the tool result, from the step_finish events of --format json

before.plugin: main: JSON.stringify(answer, null, 2) plus a diagnostic text part

after.plugin: branch: renderSearch one line per fact with id@version, scope and content, one trailer line
failed_runs: one run ended in a provider timeout after 180 s (exit 124), no answer and no step_finish

notes: The whole-plugin overhead measured in #752 (16,866 input units without the plugin against 18,345 with it) is not what this table removes: this is the share one search pays, on every search, in one step.
The free model answered with one tool call in every counted run; runs that deviated or failed were not counted.
The prompt, the facts, the binary and the model are identical in both arms; only the plugin's rendering differs.
